scope: Execution context for deterministic headless study artifacts; no benchmark outcome is modified.
shared_host_load: These campaigns overlapped a separate capacity-screen campaign on the same Mac. serial_execution in each report means serial workers inside that individual campaign, not exclusive use of the host.
valid_comparison_scope: Deterministic simulated makespan, completion, contacts, message counts and source-paired semantic outputs. Headless wall/phase maxima must not be presented as unloaded live-controller or Raspberry Pi timing measurements.

lan_timing_pause.method: SIGSTOP to the coordinator only; the current worker completed normally. No worker was suspended, so its measured simulation execution was not extended by the coordinator pause.
lan_timing_pause.boundary: After the BIOS6 seed1000 worker, before its paired BIOS7 worker.
lan_timing_pause.reason: Keep CPU-intensive headless jobs stopped during a separate actual-LAN timing trial.
lan_timing_pause.resume_context: Windows source-verification preflight required a packaging fix, so the coordinator resumed before any LAN success was established.

second_lan_timing_pause.boundary: During the first BIOS6 seed0 worker; the coordinator was stopped, but that worker was allowed to finish normally.
second_lan_timing_pause.background_load: The immediate LAN attempt was requested after Windows source preflight passed, while this headless worker and a separate capacity worker were still running. Do not describe the initial part of that LAN attempt as an unloaded-host trial.
second_lan_timing_pause.subsequent_context: The root agent confirmed no physical two-host measurement window started: the referee readiness timer expired before the Windows command was run. The coordinator resumed while readiness orchestration was being corrected.
